metadata.name: SurgeX
metadata.title: SurgeX | Bespoke AI Solutions for Your Business
metadata.description: We listen to your business, find where AI makes a real difference, and build custom solutions — websites, automations, chatbots, and more. Premium quality, fast delivery, fair prices.

items.title: Bespoke AI Solutions
items.description: We sit down with you, understand how your business works, and find exactly where AI makes a real difference. No generic products — everything is built for your specific needs.

items.title: Websites & Apps
items.description: Premium websites and apps that load fast, rank on Google, and turn visitors into customers. Custom design, not templates. Ready in days, not months.

items.title: Automation & Chatbots
items.description: Stop doing things manually. We build systems that answer your customers, follow up on leads, manage emails, and run your operations — while you focus on what matters.

items.title: Digital Marketing
items.description: Get found by the right people. Targeted ad campaigns, social media management, and content that actually drives business growth — all powered by AI.

projects.name: Harvey Salon
projects.description: Premium barbershop website with a dark cinematic aesthetic. Interactive before/after slider, team profiles, and an expandable gallery showcase.

projects.name: Vet Avencas
projects.description: Veterinary clinic website with micro-interactions and a warm, trustworthy design. Appointment system, emergency hours display, and service showcase.

projects.name: AP Jardins
projects.description: Landscaping company website showcasing outdoor projects. Service areas, gallery of completed work, and contact system for quote requests.

projects.name: Popei Gym
projects.description: Iron gym website with a bold, dark theme. Class schedule, modalities showcase, team profiles, and trial membership signup.

projects.name: Santo Amaro
projects.description: Plumbing company website with service area coverage, emergency contact system, and Google reviews integration for trust building.

projects.name: Mademoiselle
projects.description: Nail salon website with an elegant, feminine design. Service catalog, pricing display, and booking integration for appointments.

steps.title: Listen
steps.description: We sit down with you and learn how your business actually runs. No assumptions, no pushing products — just listening.

steps.title: Identify
steps.description: Together, we pinpoint where AI and automation can save you time, money, or both. We pick the highest-impact opportunity to start.

steps.title: Build & Deliver
steps.description: We build the full solution — AI, design, backend, everything. You test it, we refine it, and it goes live. Premium quality, delivered fast.

steps.title: Support & Grow
steps.description: We host it, keep it updated, fix what breaks. Once the first solution is running, we move to the next one. Long-term partnership, not a one-off project.

contact.label: CONTACT
contact.headline: Let's Talk.
contact.description: Tell us about your business and what's not working. We'll figure out together where AI can make the biggest difference.
